notes: Mostly qualitative paper. The simulated experiments (single pattern: T=2000, s=1.0, 20 clauses, Fig. 1 up to ~300 epochs; three-feature CPT: s in {1,2,5}, other parameters not stated, Fig. 2 up to ~500 epochs; two moons: T=10,000, s=1.1, 1000 clauses, 15 epochs) report no results rows, so they have no configs group; their clause counts have unclear scope (binary task, no per-class statement). Weighted clauses are used throughout (Sec. 2.1). The 0.6 selective-prediction threshold and the s=20 vs s=1.2 choice are not described as tuned on test data, so selection_on_test is not_reported. The selective accuracy and sample counts (0.932, 1231) are also annotated in Fig. 7. Unique-clause counts 6/15/22 for s=1/2/5 (p. 5) and the normalized-score example 0.389 (Fig. 8) are not in the record. Simulated runs used a MacBook Pro M3 (8 cores, 16 GB).
